notes: Job UNLDPADB step STEP01 (DFSRRC00 PARM='DLI,PAUDBUNL,PAUTBUNL'): IMS enters PAUDBUNL at ENTRY 'DLITCBL' with the one DB PCB of PSB PAUTBUNL, and it unloads the pending-authorization database DBPAUTP0 (HIDAM: root PAUTSUM0, child PAUTDTL1) with GN / GNP calls into OUTFIL1 (the roots) and OUTFIL2 (each child behind its root's key). The database is the corpus's own HD unload (data/EBCDIC/AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.IMSDATA.DBPAUTP0.dat: 22 roots, 202 children), each segment laid out by its copybook (CIPAUSMY / CIPAUDTY); its last root's key is EBCDIC spaces, so PA-ACCT-ID IS NUMERIC fails for it and it is skipped. The DL/I model is register family I (tests/equivalence/ims/ggdli.c, cobolrt/dli/DetDli.java), #4893.
